options.name: allDaySlot
options.doc: The time grid's all-day row; false: none (all-day events are then not shown there). Default true.

options.name: autoPrint
options.doc: Prepares for printing on `beforeprint` (everything drawn) and restores on `afterprint`. Default false.

options.name: availableSlots
options.doc: Bookable slots drawn in the time grid (compared by identity: a new array redraws).

options.name: businessHours
options.doc: The hours a place is open: shaded outside in the time grid and checked by `rules`. One set (`{ days, start, end }`), several, or `true` for Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00.

options.name: chooseScope
options.doc: A gesture on an occurrence of a series: how far it reaches. Resolve null to cancel. Default: a "this / following / all" menu where it dropped.

options.name: collapsedResources
options.doc: A timeline's rows: resources whose children are hidden, groups shut. Default: everything open.

options.name: contextMenu
options.resolved: (ctx: ContextMenuCtx, defaults: readonly ActionItem[]) => readonly ActionItem[] | null
options.doc: Keep, reorder, add to or replace the context menu's entries; null or [] leaves the browser's menu (an application opening its own calls preventDefault itself).

options.name: cssLayers
options.doc: The calendar's CSS in cascade layers (default true): any rule of the page outside a layer wins over it. False for a page whose global reset is unlayered (Tailwind 3, Bootstrap's reboot, normalize.css): the CSS is then plain, its class selectors outweigh those resets, and a page rule of the same weight coming after it wins. The first calendar of a document decides.

options.name: customButtons
options.doc: The application's buttons, named in `headerToolbar`.

options.name: dayMaxLanes
options.doc: Lanes a month day shows before "+N": a number, 'auto' (as many as the height allows), or null (every event: the weeks grow, the month scrolls). Default: null in a month (nothing hidden unless asked), 'auto' in a year's tiny days.

options.name: density
options.doc: Default 'comfortable'.

options.name: displayCalendar
options.doc: The calendar dates are written in ('islamic-umalqura', 'persian'…; Intl's names). The data and the grids stay Gregorian; titles, numbers and labels follow it. Default: the locale's.

options.name: displayEventTime
options.doc: An event's time beside its title; false: the title alone. Default true.

options.name: dragEdgeNavigate
options.doc: Holding a dragged event at the side goes to the previous/next period. Default true.

options.name: droppable
options.doc: What may be dropped here from the page (`makeDraggable`) or another calendar: true, false (default), or a filter given the element's data.

options.name: editable
options.doc: Events can be dragged and resized, and the context menu offers editing entries. Default false.

options.name: eventMaxStack
options.doc: Overlapping events side by side in a time grid before "+N": a number, 'auto' (as many as the column's width allows, about 2.5rem each) or null (all, however thin). Default 'auto'.

options.name: eventResizableFromStart
options.doc: Timed events can be resized from their start too. Default false.

options.name: eventStyle
options.doc: Events tinted with their tone's edge ('tinted', the default) or filled blocks of their tone ('solid').

options.name: events
options.doc: Loaded as an array source named "events"; replaced with `setEvents`.

options.name: firstDay
options.doc: Default: the locale's.

options.name: formats
options.doc: How each place is written: `{ slotLabel: { hour: 'numeric' }, title: (t) => … }` (docs/behaviors/formats.md).

options.name: headerItems
options.doc: The application's places in the header (a menu, a filter, a badge), named in `headerToolbar`: its content, classes and mounts.

options.name: headerToolbar
options.doc: What the header holds and where (`'prev,next today'`: a space between groups, a comma inside one); false: no header. Default: the arrows joined and "today" at the start, the title in the centre, `headerViews` at the end.

options.name: headerViews
options.doc: The view switcher's buttons. Default: month, week, day — those this renderer draws. Without `headerToolbar`.

options.name: hiddenDays
options.doc: Weekdays no view shows (ISO: 6 and 7 for the weekend), unless a view names its own.

options.name: historyLimit
options.doc: Undo entries kept. Default 200.

options.name: hooks
options.doc: The calendar's elements made the application's: per element (`event`, `dayCell`, `slotLabel`…), its classes, content and mounts (docs/behaviors/render-hooks.md).

members.name: allDayLabel
members.doc: The all-day row's label.

members.name: dayCell
members.doc: A day's cell (a month, a day grid's week).

members.name: dayHeader
members.doc: A day's head (a week's or a day's date, a month's weekday): a mark, a count, a button.

members.name: dayLane
members.doc: A time grid's column for a day.

members.name: listDayHeader
members.doc: A list's day heading.

members.name: monthHeader
members.doc: A month's title in a multi-month view.

members.name: morePopover
members.doc: The panel "+N" opens.

members.name: noEvents
members.doc: The list's "nothing to show".

members.name: nowIndicator
members.doc: The line at the current time.

members.name: resourceAreaHeader
members.doc: A timeline's resource column head.

members.name: resourceGroupHeader
members.doc: A group's head (resource views) and its row (a timeline).

members.name: resourceLane
members.doc: A resource's row in a timeline.

members.name: slotLabel
members.doc: A time label in a time grid's gutter.

members.name: slotLane
members.doc: A slot's row across a time grid (drawn as elements only when this hook is given).

members.name: view
members.doc: The view's root.

members.name: weekNumber
members.doc: A week's number.

options.name: initialDate
options.doc: Default: today in `timeZone`.

options.name: injectStyles
options.doc: False under a CSP without inline styles: include `DZ_CSS` yourself.

options.name: kernel
options.doc: A kernel built elsewhere (shared store, tests). Otherwise one is made from the options.

options.name: keyboardUndo
options.doc: Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z undo and redo inside the calendar. Default true.

options.name: look
options.doc: 'none': the structure only (grids, positions, sizes) — every colour, border, shadow and type yours (Tailwind, a design system). Default 'styled'.

options.name: messages
options.doc: Any of the words, over the locale's (EN and FR built in; `@dzcalendar/dom/locales/ar|es|de`, `defineLocale` for a complete set; else EN).

options.name: motion
options.doc: The calendar owns it from here: it is destroyed with the calendar, or when replaced.

options.name: multiMonthMaxColumns
options.doc: Months side by side at most in a multi-month view (1: a stack). Default 3.

options.name: nowIndicator
options.doc: The line at the current time, refreshed every minute. Default true.

options.name: onCommandRefused
options.doc: A command from the calendar's own UI was refused: why (problems, rule violations).

options.name: onCreateRequest
options.doc: "New event here" from the context menu: the application opens its own editor. A moment in a time grid, a date in a month.

options.name: onDrop
options.doc: An element of the page was dropped and its event made (not on a refusal).

options.name: onEventChange
options.doc: After a person's change: persist it, and `revert()` it if the server refuses.

options.name: onEventLeave
options.doc: An event of this calendar was dropped on another one: `revert()` puts it back on both.

options.name: onEventOpen
options.doc: "Open" from the context menu.

options.name: onEventReceive
options.doc: An event came in (dropped from the page or from another calendar): persist it; `revert()` takes it back (both calendars' sides).

options.name: onProblem
options.doc: Something the calendar could not do as asked, found while drawing; without it, said once per code on the console.

options.name: onProposalRefused
options.doc: A gesture dropped where the rules refuse it (the proposal and its violations).

options.name: onResourceProblems
options.doc: What the resources given (option or `update`) could not be read as: refused entries, dropped fields. Called only when there are some.

options.name: onResourceToggle
options.type: (state: { readonly collapsedResources: readonly string[]; readonly collapsedGroups: readonly string[] }) => void
options.resolved: (state: { readonly collapsedResources: readonly string[]; readonly collapsedGroups: readonly string[]; }) => void
options.doc: A person folded or unfolded a resource or a group (a timeline's tree): the state to keep, if the application wants it back.

options.name: onSlotClick
options.doc: A free slot of `availableSlots` was clicked (or Enter on it): the slot as given. The application books it — its server checks it again (`checkSlot`) before saving; the calendar creates nothing.

options.name: onSource
options.doc: Loading, fetch errors, problems in a delivery, saves refused.

options.name: onUnselect
options.doc: The selection shown went away (a click elsewhere, Escape, another period) — not when the application cleared it.

options.name: resourceGroupField
options.doc: Resource views group their columns (a timeline its rows) by this field: a head over each run.

options.name: resourceOrder
options.resolved: string | readonly string[] | ((a: Resource, b: Resource) => number)
options.doc: How sibling resources are ordered after their `order`: field names (`'-title'` descending) or a comparison.

options.name: resources
options.doc: What resource views show as columns (`setResources` replaces them).

options.name: rules
options.doc: What edits are checked against (business hours come from `businessHours`).

options.name: scheme
options.doc: Light, dark, or the page's ('auto'). Default 'auto'.

options.name: scrollTime
options.doc: Where the time grid is scrolled to on first paint. Default PT8H.

options.name: secondaryCalendar
options.doc: A second calendar shown beside the dates (a cell's day, a heading's date). Default none.

options.name: selectable
options.doc: Dragging across empty time selects it (`onSelect`). Default false.

options.name: showUnassigned
options.doc: Resource views add an "Unassigned" column (a timeline a row) first, for events on no known resource. Default false.

options.name: snapMinutes
options.doc: Minutes gestures and context-menu moments snap to in a time grid. Default 15.

options.name: sources
options.doc: Fetched as the calendar moves (`kernel.sources` adds, removes, refetches).

options.name: store
options.doc: A store to share: four kernels on one store show the same events in four zones.

options.name: theme
options.doc: A ready-made family ('standard', 'slate', 'night', 'pastel', 'frost', 'solar', 'contrast' — with `@dzcalendar/theme`) or one made with `defineTheme`. Default 'standard'.

members.name: axis
members.doc: 'wall': every day's rows aligned, a clock change marked; 'elapsed': real time drawn to scale.

members.name: labelMinutes
members.doc: A tick labelled every this many minutes of the clock (whole multiples of `slotMinutes` make sense). Default 60.

members.name: minEventMinutes
members.doc: The shortest an event is drawn, in minutes. Default 15.

members.name: slotMax
members.doc: The end of the last hour shown (up to 24 hours).

members.name: slotMin
members.doc: The first hour shown (a duration from midnight).

members.name: slotMinutes
members.doc: Gutter tick step, in minutes. Default 60.

options.name: timeline
options.type: { readonly slot?: number | 'day'; readonly maxLanes?: number; readonly fillLanes?: number }
options.doc: A timeline's scale and rows (the Pro's family reads them).

members.name: fillLanes
members.doc: Lanes of a timeline without resources (its one row fills the view: the DOM measures it). Default 12.

members.name: maxLanes
members.doc: Lanes a resource row shows before "+N". Default 3.

members.name: slot
members.doc: Minutes per slot (dividing a day) or 'day'. Default: 30 for a day, 60 up to a week, days beyond.

options.name: titleFormat
options.doc: How the title is written; default: the month, a week's days, a day in full.

options.name: viewOptions
options.doc: Options of a plugin's views, by family (`{ timeline: { areaColumns, … } }` for the Pro's timeline).

options.name: views
options.doc: Added to (and overriding) the built-in views: a whole spec, or settings (`{ family: 'timeGrid', visibleRange }`) the rest filled in, the type its key.

options.name: virtualizeAbove
options.doc: Above this many events in a view, only what is on screen (and a margin) is mounted; below, everything (what a screen reader's browse mode reads). Default 500; `Infinity` never windows.

options.name: weekNumbers
options.doc: A number per week: on the month's rows, in the week's corner. Default false.

options.name: weekends
options.doc: False hides Saturday and Sunday (added to `hiddenDays`). Default true.
